decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-dbce621da33f] comes from the "Removed features" section of the Crossplane v2 upgrade guide. It names the subject: the ControllerConfig type, deprecated since v1.11. The change is that v2.0 removes it and replaces it with DeploymentRuntimeConfig. The excerpt also says who is exposed: anyone with ControllerConfig resources, who must convert them, for example with the v1.20 CLI command `crossplane beta convert deployment-runtime`. The excerpt does not spell out exactly what happens on upgrade, but the removal heading supports a consequence that ControllerConfig is no longer supported in v2.0, so an engineer can write the typed assertion.
